## 🛡️ **SECURITY COMPLIANCE VERIFICATION (DETAILED)**

| Control | Verification Method | Result |
|-------|---------------------|--------|
| **Zero Public Exposure** | Network policy review + VPC flow logs | ✅ No public IP exposure; all services behind Istio ingress gateway |
| **TLS Hardening** | SSL Labs test + Open Policy Agent (OPA) policy enforcement | ✅ All endpoints use TLS 1.3 with strong ciphers (no weak protocols) |
| **HSTS Enforcement** | HTTP header inspection via `curl -I` + WAF logs | ✅ HSTS enabled (`max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload`) |
| **Certificate Rotation** | Vault audit trail + cert-manager controller logs | ✅ Auto-rotation in place; no manual intervention required |
| **Secrets Management** | HashiCorp Vault access logs + KMS key usage | ✅ Secrets encrypted at rest; least-privilege access enforced |
| **IAM Policies** | AWS IAM Access Advisor + ScoutSuite scan | ✅ No overprivileged roles; principal-only access to production resources |
| **GitOps Integrity** | Git commit history + Argo CD sync logs | ✅ All changes traceable; signed commits only; no direct kubectl access |

> ✅ **All security controls are active, auditable, and aligned with [PERFSEC-DP89] requirements.**

---

## ⚙️ **OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE CHECKS**

| Criterion | Status | Notes |
|--------|--------|-------|
| **Automated Rollback** | ✅ Enabled | Triggered on health check failure or latency > 89ms |
| **Blue/Green Isolation** | ✅ Verified | No shared state between environments; separate PVCs, ConfigMaps |
| **CI/CD Pipeline Integrity** | ✅ Validated | Jenkins + Argo CD pipeline uses signed images (Cosign), SBOM scanning (Syft + Trivy) |
| **Observability Stack** | ✅ Active | Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo fully integrated; alerts routed to PagerDuty |
| **Backup & Recovery** | ✅ Tested | Staging restore completed successfully; RTO < 5 min, RPO = 1 min |

> ✅ **Operational resilience confirmed. System is self-healing and observable.**
